question.worked_solution:
To find the root of $f(x),$  we must solve $f(x)=0\mathbin{:}$

$$
\log(2x) - 2 = 0
$$

We solve this equation by making $x$ the subject, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{log}⁡(2x)-2 & =0 \\ \operatorname{log}⁡(2x) & =2 \\ {10}^{\operatorname{log}⁡(2x)} & ={10}^{2} \\ 2x & =100 \\ x & =50\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the root of $f(x)$ is $x=50.$
